ex.en: Tom and Mary argue with each other all the time.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗總是在吵架。

ex.en: I argued with Yoko a little bit.
ex.zh: 我跟洋子吵了一下。

ex.en: It is no use arguing with him about it.
ex.zh: 跟他爭論這件事是沒用的。

ex.en: Columbus argued that he could reach India by going west.
ex.zh: 哥倫布主張往西航行可以到達印度。

ex.en: Some experts argue that the plan will not work.
ex.zh: 有些專家認為這個計畫行不通。

ex.en: The article on Buddhism revived my interest in oriental religions.
ex.zh: 那篇關於佛教的文章又燃起了我對東方宗教的興趣。

ex.en: He has just published an interesting series of articles.
ex.zh: 他剛發表了一系列有趣的文章。

ex.en: I've boldfaced the articles that I found interesting.
ex.zh: 我把覺得有趣的文章用粗體標出來了。

ex.en: "A" and "the" are articles.
ex.zh: a 和 the 是冠詞。

ex.en: Many learners forget to use articles.
ex.zh: 很多學習者會忘記用冠詞。

ex.en: Everyone was more or less interested in the arts.
ex.zh: 每個人多少都對藝術有點興趣。

ex.en: They awarded her first prize at the art exhibition.
ex.zh: 她在美術展中獲得首獎。

ex.en: She took night classes in the art of self-defense.
ex.zh: 她上夜間課程學防身術。

ex.en: Cooking is an art.
ex.zh: 烹飪是一門藝術。

ex.en: The poor young man finally became a great artist.
ex.zh: 這位窮困的年輕人最後成了偉大的藝術家。

ex.en: He is one of the greatest artists in Japan.
ex.zh: 他是日本最偉大的藝術家之一。

ex.en: She will be a famous artist in the future.
ex.zh: 她將來會是一個有名的藝術家。

ex.en: Thousands of workers and artisans toiled for 22 years to create this breathtaking white marble structure.
ex.zh: 數千名工人和工匠辛勤工作了 22 年，才打造出這座令人驚歎的白色大理石建築。

ex.en: Farther from the palace and to its north and south were the commoners, merchants, artisans, and laborers.
ex.zh: 離皇宮較遠的南北兩邊，住的是平民、商人、工匠和勞工。

ex.en: She studied archaeology at university.
ex.zh: 她大學念考古學。

ex.en: Archaeology helps us understand how people lived long ago.
ex.zh: 考古學幫助我們了解古人的生活。

ex.en: The museum displays artifacts from ancient Egypt.
ex.zh: 博物館展出古埃及的文物。

ex.en: Archaeologists found many artifacts at the site.
ex.zh: 考古學家在遺址發現了許多文物。

ex.en: Japan is an archipelago of thousands of islands.
ex.zh: 日本是由數千座島嶼組成的群島。

ex.en: The Philippines is a large archipelago in Southeast Asia.
ex.zh: 菲律賓是東南亞的大群島。

ex.en: I created an archive of my emails.
ex.zh: 我把電子郵件都做了封存備份。

ex.en: I'm downloading this internet archive.
ex.zh: 我正在下載這份網路封存資料。

ex.en: Old emails are archived automatically after a year.
ex.zh: 舊郵件一年後會自動封存。

ex.en: Please archive these files at the end of the project.
ex.zh: 專案結束後請把這些檔案歸檔。

ex.en: The precise time of their arrival is not known.
ex.zh: 他們到達的確切時間還不明。

ex.en: On his arrival at the station, he called a taxi.
ex.zh: 他到了火車站，就叫了輛計程車。

ex.en: What's the flight's scheduled arrival time?
ex.zh: 飛機預計幾點到？

ex.en: With the arrival of winter, leaves fall from the trees.
ex.zh: 樹上的葉子隨著冬天的到來而掉落。

ex.en: The arrival of spring brings warmer weather.
ex.zh: 春天到來，天氣也跟著變暖了。

ex.en: Sometimes he has difficulty being articulate about his views.
ex.zh: 他有時很難把自己的看法說清楚。

ex.en: She is an articulate speaker.
ex.zh: 她是一位口才很好的講者。

ex.en: He found it hard to articulate his feelings.
ex.zh: 他覺得很難清楚說出自己的感受。

ex.en: Try to articulate your main point in one sentence.
ex.zh: 試著用一句話清楚說出你的重點。
